engine: a-identity-near-engine/1.1.0 (policy near-default/1; collector a-identity-near-sdk/0.2.0); block: the first block at or after the account's creation + 1 day

signals_off.third_party_registries: off (--no-third-party): MimicWatch's 2026-11-01 scan is the source of the three researcher_dataset suspicious rows, so its registry would leak labels; Tripwire, near-leash and Leash commons list testnet demo accounts
signals_off.a_identity_registry: off (--registry none): no A-Identity registry is deployed on mainnet, and none holding verdicts written from this dataset may be read
signals_off.vault: off (no --vault): no prior payments, refusals or owner allowlist
signals_off.known_from_labels: off: the known list is known-brands.json (top 25 NEP-141 tokens by on-chain market cap on NearBlocks), not the known_good rows

known.rule: The first 25 tokens of NearBlocks public token list ordered by on-chain market cap, descending, as returned by one GET on 2026-11-12. The rule was fixed before the list was fetched and before any benchmark verdict was computed. The list was not edited after fetching. The rule does not read scan/dataset.json, its labels, its seed files, its cited sources, or the brands the suspicious rows imitate.

at_age.rule: each account pinned to the first block at or after its own creation block's timestamp + days * 86400 s; the creation block is proven from the chain (plan.json)

run.selection: every suspicious and known_good row of scan/dataset.json (76 accounts); lookalike_candidate rows are not run
run.generated_by: scan/benchmark/at-age/run.mjs (verdicts derived from plan.json and the snapshots; --offline rebuilds this file)
